verdict.rationale: Mercury ships one official SDK (Go, generated via Stainless) plus a documented REST API, OpenAPI-adjacent docs, and interactive reference with multi-language code samples, but explicitly has no official Python or JS/TS SDK — only community packages like n8n-nodes-mercury — which is a major gap for AI-native builders who overwhelmingly work in Python/TypeScript. Missing for 10: official Python SDK, official JS/TS SDK, independent hands-on validation of SDK usage in production agent workflows.
